bio.text: Seth Kuhl-Stennes, of Minneapolis, is the Green Party candidate for Minnesota secretary of state in 2026; his KAXE candidate survey response lists his employment as operations specialist at the Land Stewardship Project.

In his KAXE candidate survey response, Kuhl-Stennes said he was born and raised in Baudette, earned a political science degree from the College of Saint Benedict and Saint John's University, and has lived in the Twin Cities area since 2006.
